# WristSkill

> wristskill.com is the site of WristSkill Labs, LLC — the software practice of Joseph Sharaya, OTD, OTR/L, CHT, an occupational therapist and Certified Hand Therapist. It covers the WristSkill iPhone app for wrist proprioception assessment and training, clinician-written reference guides on wrist rehabilitation, and the family apps Shower Tally and Frozen Fortune.

WristSkill (the app) measures wrist performance across six movement planes using iPhone tilt input — three metrics per plane: targets hit, time efficiency, and path efficiency. It is not a medical device, and its psychometric properties have not yet been published; validation studies are in development.

## WristSkill app

- [Home](https://wristskill.com/): what the app measures, the three metrics, and the six-plane structure
- [The research](https://wristskill.com/research): the clinical case — wrist proprioception evidence, the measurement gap, what the app does and does not claim, with references
- [Dart Thrower's Motion clinical guide](https://wristskill.com/dtm): DTM biomechanics, proximal row protection, PNF D2 mapping, and diagnosis-by-diagnosis rehabilitation guidance
- [Functional goals](https://wristskill.com/functional-goals): copyable SMART goal templates for hand therapy documentation, by injury type
- [Ulnar-sided wrist pain](https://wristskill.com/ulnar-sided-wrist-pain): causes, mechanics, and when to seek evaluation
- [About](https://wristskill.com/about): who builds WristSkill, research partnerships, and contact

## Family apps

- [Shower Tally](https://wristskill.com/shower-tally/): a family shower-tracking iPhone app — a shared real-time board of who's showered and who's overdue
- [Shower Tally blog](https://wristskill.com/shower-tally/blog/): guides on hygiene routines for ADHD adults, family caregivers, parents, and I/DD support staff
- [Frozen Fortune](https://wristskill.com/frozen-fortune/): a browser-based ice-cream-truck business game for kids 8–14

## Other

- [Projects](https://wristskill.com/projects): portfolio of shipped software — iOS apps, Chrome extensions, and web tools
